nodes.purpose: Turn user intent into testable scope, acceptance checks, non-goals, risk, and rails.
outputs: accepted ADLC ticket or execution-plan brief
evidence: acceptance criterion paired with a verification method
nodes.acceptance: Scope and stop condition are executable without guessing.
nodes.stopCondition: Proceed when intent is accepted; otherwise escalate unresolved product choices.
nodes.idempotency: Updating the same artifact preserves its identity and decision history.

nodes.purpose: Map the relevant code, contracts, invariants, tests, and blast radius without mutation.
nodes.acceptance: Every proposed write area has an observed reason.
nodes.stopCondition: Stop when the smallest coherent write scope is known.
nodes.idempotency: Repeated exploration does not mutate product state.

nodes.purpose: Choose the smallest vertical implementation and verification sequence.
nodes.acceptance: Each step has an observable completion condition.
nodes.stopCondition: Proceed once the plan fits scope and rails.
nodes.idempotency: Plan updates append decisions instead of erasing history.

nodes.purpose: Implement one accepted vertical slice with its tests and documentation.
nodes.acceptance: The slice meets its acceptance checks without crossing rails.
nodes.stopCondition: Stop on acceptance, unchanged third failure, rail conflict, or authorization need.
nodes.idempotency: Retries converge on the same requested behavior and do not duplicate migrations or side effects.

nodes.purpose: Run deterministic structural, architecture, type, test, and build gates.
nodes.stopCondition: Pass to review; revise only with new evidence; escalate the unchanged third failure.
nodes.idempotency: Verification is read-only except disposable build and evidence artifacts.

nodes.purpose: Independently challenge correctness, security, contracts, diff quality, and test strength.
outputs: PASS, REVISE, or ESCALATE verdict with findings
nodes.stopCondition: Return an explicit verdict; never self-accept on behalf of a human.
nodes.idempotency: Review does not modify product files or record acceptance.

nodes.purpose: Let an accountable human accept the outcome and remaining risk.
nodes.acceptance: The authorized owner explicitly accepts the scoped outcome.
nodes.stopCondition: Terminate accepted or route to escalation/revision.
nodes.idempotency: A stable decision key prevents duplicate acceptance side effects.

nodes.purpose: Stop safely with evidence when intent, authorization, rails, or bounded retries block progress.
nodes.acceptance: The owner can decide without reconstructing the run.
nodes.stopCondition: Terminate until the owner supplies a decision or authorization.
nodes.idempotency: Repeated escalation updates one decision request.
